pages.title: Create Integrated Farming
pages.text:
**Create Integrated Farming** adds farming machines for contraptions:

- a **Vacuum Harvester**
- **Roosts** for poultry
- **Fishing Nets** that fish while moving

Several recipes use Farmer's Delight items.

pages.title: Vacuum Harvester
pages.text: Rotation charges its chamber (30 s at 64 [#](7A3C9A)[RPM](entry://glossary/rpm)[#]() by default). At full pressure it harvests every mature crop around it at once. Take output from any side but the shaft.

On a contraption the chamber charges on a timer, even while parked. Each pulse covers the whole area around its position. Contraption Controls can pause it.\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#]().

pages.title: Roost
pages.text: Right-click a bird with an empty Roost to catch it, or lead one in. Poultry produce over time; feeding speeds it up, by hand, belt or Arm.

pages.title: Fishing Net
pages.text: Made from Farmer's Delight's Safety Net. Moved on a contraption it fishes in open water or lava: the fish rods catch there, small ones most. It also catches small animals.

Mechanical Arms can harvest lily pads and powdery crops. A Spout speeds up [Organic Compost](item://farmersdelight:organic_compost) decay, which feeds Farmer's Delight's Rich Soil.\
\
Animals: [#](2E5AAC)[Animals](entry://food/animals)[#](). Delight basics: [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().
